sermon.title: Increase of Knowledge and Israel
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this present truth session Pastor David G. Kincer reviews the marks of the Bible last days and teaches on two of them: the increase of knowledge foretold in Daniel 12:4 and the restoration of Israel as a nation in 1948. He says knowledge confirms the Bible as a book of facts, that God is restoring both natural and spiritual Israel, and that no one knows the day of Christ’s return.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor note: he gives “1 Chronicles 12:38” for the children of Issachar; that verse is 1 Chronicles 12:32 (shown). The captions read “Daniel 128,” “Job 267,” “Acts 539” and “Romans 112 24-26,” rendered Daniel 12:8, Job 26:7, Acts 5:39 and Romans 11:24-26. His Ecclesiastes reference was not clear. His dates and figures (inventions, the tablets found in Syria, the Piltdown, Lucy and other “missing link” claims, 995,000 taken captive in 70 AD, Israel’s population and religious percentages, including a captioned “177%”) and his statements about Darwin, scientists, the United Nations, Muslim nations and politicians are his own and are not verified here. A few words and names are marked [unclear].

faqs.question: When are the Bible last days?
faqs.answer: He says the last days run from 33 AD till the day of the Lord, the second return; they are the days of salvation and the outpouring of God’s Spirit.

faqs.question: When does he say the falling away happened?
faqs.answer: He says it happened from about 500 AD to about 1500 AD, when the church was very corrupt and lost basic truth from the early church.

faqs.question: Why does he say Jesus has not come yet?
faqs.answer: He says the gospel must be preached to all nations as a witness first; other nations were not even discovered till 1500 AD, “and there’s a lot of things we haven’t discovered is why he is hasn’t come yet.”

faqs.question: Should we trust books that say the end is near?
faqs.answer: He says everybody is trying to sell books and promote their name by predicting the end: “forget them.”

faqs.question: What did the telescope prove about the stars?
faqs.answer: He says the telescope proved that the stars were innumerable and growing, just like the Bible says.

faqs.question: Why do some scientists call the flood a myth?
faqs.answer: He says humanistic scientists who want to reject Christ and live in sin call it “the myth of the flood,” even though the flood is mentioned in many artifacts.

faqs.question: Is the nation of Israel serving God today?
faqs.answer: He says they are not serving God yet and are not grafted in; only a small percentage are Christian, but there will be a move of God to turn them back to Jesus Christ.

faqs.question: Is the church the Israel of God?
faqs.answer: He says “we are the Israel of God,” and God is recovering and restoring both the natural Jew and the spiritual Jew.

faqs.question: What should believers read instead of prophecy books?
faqs.answer: He says to get away from people making money off books and tapes and get back to the writings of John, Paul, Matthew and Timothy.

faqs.question: Should Christians worry about blood moons?
faqs.answer: He says don’t get people troubled and worried about blood moons “and all this nonsense”; no one knows the day or the hour.

faqs.question: How will people know when the end comes?
faqs.answer: He says the Bible says in Matthew 24 that when the end comes everyone will see and know.

faqs.question: Is the Bible a book of myths?
faqs.answer: He says the fulfillments prove the Bible is “a supernatural book” written by God: “it’s not a book of myths it’s a book of facts it’s a book of truth.”
